Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: Activities, Molecule_Dictionary, Compound_Structures. Join: Activities to Molecule_Dictionary via molregno; Molecule_Dictionary to Compound_Structures via molregno. Filter: assay_chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1054502'; standard_value is not null; standard_relation equals '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ascending, chembl_id ascending, standard_type ascending, standard_relation ascending, standard_value ascending, standard_units ascending.
